# robinhood-chain-sdk

> Official TypeScript SDK for the Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663) API — EVM-native on-chain trading intelligence.

## What is Robinhood Chain?

Robinhood Chain (RHC) is an Arbitrum Orbit L2, chain id 4663. MadeOnSol (https://madeonsol.com/robinhood) runs a self-hosted node and exposes EVM-native intelligence over the same paid v1 API and the same `msk_` API key as the Solana product — bundled into every tier at no extra cost. All addresses are lowercase `0x`, amounts are `eth_amount`, transactions are `tx_hash`, and blocks are `block_number`.

- **KOL Trades**: live buy/sell feed from tracked Solana KOLs' verified EVM wallets, a KOL activity leaderboard, consensus "hot tokens" (2+ KOLs), and per-KOL profiles.
- **KOL Signals**: coordination (tokens N+ distinct KOLs are buying, with the cohort breakdown) and first touches (the earliest KOL entry per token).
- **Tokens**: token discovery, per-token snapshot (price/MC/FDV/peak/drawdown, deployer reputation, KOL activity, pools), 1-minute OHLC candles, KOL consensus (`net_flow_eth`), early-buyer quality (0–100), same-block launch-bundle detection, top traders by realized ETH, cohort flow, peak history, live on-chain risk (simulated sellability), exact holders from Transfer logs, and batch reads (50 tokens; 20 for buyer-quality).
- **DEX Trade Tape**: every Uniswap v2/v3/v4 swap with the effective trading account (tx.from, or the ERC-4337 userOp sender when bundled), gas/ordering for MEV analysis, and KOL/deployer flags.
- **Deployer Hunter**: reputation leaderboard, per-deployer profiles, trajectory, launch history, best tokens, chain-wide stats, the alert feed, and recent graduations (graduation = $40K peak MC, runner = $100K; the elite/good tier rides runner_rate + 24h of deployer history).
- **Alpha Wallets**: smart-money ranking by realized on-chain performance (net ETH, win rate, memecoin share), with bot-fleet flagging.
- **Rule engines (push, not polling)**: copy-trade rules, MC dip/recovery price alerts, KOL coordination rules, and KOL first-touch subscriptions — delivered over webhook (HMAC-SHA256 signed) or WebSocket. Quotas are PER CHAIN: RHC rules never consume the Solana allowance.
- **Streaming**: managed WebSocket for six channels — `rhc:kol_trades` (PRO+), `rhc:dex_trades` (the DEX firehose, ULTRA+), and the four rule-engine channels `rhc:copytrade:signals`, `rhc:price_alert:events`, `rhc:kol:coordination` (all PRO+, user-scoped) and `rhc:kol:first_touches` (PRO+ broadcast). `rhc:trades` is a deprecated alias of `rhc:dex_trades`. Server `channels_rejected` warnings surface as a `"warning"` event.

## Installation

```
npm install robinhood-chain-sdk
```

## Authentication

Get a free API key at https://madeonsol.com/pricing (starts with `msk_`).

```typescript
import { RobinhoodClient } from "robinhood-chain-sdk";
const client = new RobinhoodClient({ apiKey: "msk_your_api_key_here" });
```

## Methods (all 52 endpoints)

### KOL (client.kol) — BASIC
- `client.kol.feed(params?)` — GET /rhc/kol/feed — live KOL trade feed
- `client.kol.leaderboard(params?)` — GET /rhc/kol/leaderboard — KOL activity leaderboard
- `client.kol.hotTokens(params?)` — GET /rhc/kol/hot-tokens — tokens bought by 2+ KOLs
- `client.kol.coordination(params?)` — GET /rhc/kol/coordination — tokens bought by N+ distinct KOLs, with the per-KOL cohort breakdown, net ETH, accumulating/distributing and exit state
- `client.kol.firstTouches(params?)` — GET /rhc/kol/first-touches — the globally earliest KOL buy per token (limit clamped to 20 below PRO; first_kol.evm_address is ULTRA-only)
- `client.kol.wallet(wallet)` — GET /rhc/kol/{wallet} — single KOL profile

### DEX tape (client.trades) — PRO+
- `client.trades(params?)` — GET /rhc/trades — Uniswap v2/v3/v4 trade tape

### Tokens (client.tokens)
- `client.tokens.list(params?)` — GET /rhc/tokens — token discovery (PRO+)
- `client.tokens.get(address)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address} — token snapshot (BASIC)
- `client.tokens.candles(address, params?)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address}/candles — 1m OHLC (PRO+)
- `client.tokens.kolConsensus(address)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address}/kol-consensus (PRO+)
- `client.tokens.buyerQuality(address)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address}/buyer-quality (BASIC)
- `client.tokens.bundle(address)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address}/bundle — launch-bundle detection (BASIC)
- `client.tokens.topTraders(address, params?)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address}/top-traders — ranked by REALIZED ETH (sell − buy), not PnL (PRO+)
- `client.tokens.flow(address, window?)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address}/flow — net flow by cohort; positive net_eth = that cohort distributed (PRO+)
- `client.tokens.peakHistory(address, params?)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address}/peak-history — recorded vs observed peak MC + high-water curve (PRO+)
- `client.tokens.risk(address)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address}/risk — EVM-native risk computed live on-chain; sellability is simulated, never cached (PRO+)
- `client.tokens.holders(address, params?)` — GET /rhc/tokens/{address}/holders — exact holders from Transfer logs; check `verified` first, balances are decimal strings (PRO+)
- `client.tokens.batch(addresses)` — POST /rhc/token/batch — up to 50 tokens in one call; unknown addresses echo back as found:false (BASIC)
- `client.tokens.batchBuyerQuality(addresses)` — POST /rhc/tokens/batch/buyer-quality — MAX 20 (not the Solana 50 — per-token cohort computation); per-token failures degrade to an error entry (BASIC)

### Deployer Hunter (client.deployerHunter)
Tier semantics (migrations 267 + 269): elite/good are earned on the $100K runner_rate AND require 24h of deployer history. graduation_rate still means the $40K bar and is still returned, but no longer sets the tier; only spammer still keys off it.
- `client.deployerHunter.leaderboard(params?)` — GET /rhc/deployer-hunter/leaderboard (BASIC)
- `client.deployerHunter.profile(address)` — GET /rhc/deployer-hunter/{address} (BASIC)
- `client.deployerHunter.trajectory(address)` — GET /rhc/deployer-hunter/{address}/trajectory — streaks, rolling 10-launch success curve, trend; success event is the $40K graduation (BASIC)
- `client.deployerHunter.tokens(address, params?)` — GET /rhc/deployer-hunter/{address}/tokens — paginated launch history; sort=peak_mc_usd is page-scoped (BASIC)
- `client.deployerHunter.history(address, params?)` — GET /rhc/deployer-hunter/{address}/history — deploy history + reputation row (PRO+)
- `client.deployerHunter.bestTokens(params?)` — GET /rhc/deployer-hunter/best-tokens — highest-peaking tokens from elite/good deployers (BASIC)
- `client.deployerHunter.stats()` — GET /rhc/deployer-hunter/stats — chain-wide tier population, spam share, alert volume, active tier_rules (BASIC)
- `client.deployerHunter.alerts(params?)` — GET /rhc/deployer-hunter/alerts — new_deploy/graduated feed; tradability-filtered by default (liquidity_usd >= $100, unknown fails — include_untradeable=true disables it); tier resolved at read time with tier_at_alert + tier_is_stale (BASIC)
- `client.deployerHunter.recentBonds(params?)` — GET /rhc/deployer-hunter/recent-bonds — recent $40K peak-MC graduations (BASIC)

### Alpha Wallets (client.alphaWallets) — PRO+
- `client.alphaWallets(params?)` — GET /rhc/alpha-wallets — smart-money ranking

### Rule engines — push, not polling
Quotas are PER CHAIN — RHC rules never consume the Solana allowance. `webhook_secret` is returned once on create (null for delivery_mode "websocket"); webhook payloads are HMAC-SHA256 signed over `<timestamp>.<body>` in X-MadeOnSol-Signature.
- `client.copyTrade.list()` — GET /rhc/copytrade/subscriptions (PRO+)
- `client.copyTrade.create(params)` — POST /rhc/copytrade/subscriptions — follow up to 250 wallets; sizes are ETH, and there is NO market-cap band (the RHC trade event carries no market cap) (PRO+)
- `client.copyTrade.get(id)` / `.update(id, params)` / `.delete(id)` — GET/PATCH/DELETE /rhc/copytrade/subscriptions/{id} — numeric id; update re-checks the per-tier wallet cap (PRO+)
- `client.copyTrade.signals(params?)` — GET /rhc/copytrade/signals — fire history, retained 7 days (PRO+)
- `client.priceAlerts.list()` — GET /rhc/price-alerts (PRO+)
- `client.priceAlerts.create(params)` — POST /rhc/price-alerts — baseline MC captured at creation; token must already be tracked with an MC; alerts expire after 30 days (PRO+)
- `client.priceAlerts.get(id)` / `.update(id, params)` / `.delete(id)` — GET/PATCH/DELETE /rhc/price-alerts/{id} — numeric id; only name, delivery_mode, webhook_url, is_active are mutable (PRO+)
- `client.priceAlerts.events(params?)` — GET /rhc/price-alerts/events — dip/recovery fire history, retained 30 days (PRO+)
- RHC price alerts are POLLED (~15s off rhc_token_prices), NOT sub-second like the Solana alerts — the create response says so in its `evaluation` block.
- `client.kol.coordinationAlerts.list()` — GET /rhc/kol/coordination/alerts (PRO+)
- `client.kol.coordinationAlerts.create(params)` — POST /rhc/kol/coordination/alerts — fire when N+ tracked KOLs buy the same token in a rolling window; scoring uses the shared v1 scorer with `earliness` DEFAULTED on RHC and `quality` a real KOL win-rate (PRO+)
- `client.kol.coordinationAlerts.get(id)` / `.update(id, params)` / `.delete(id)` — GET/PATCH/DELETE /rhc/kol/coordination/alerts/{id} — UUID id (PRO+)
- `client.kol.firstTouchSubscriptions.list()` — GET /rhc/kol/first-touches/subscriptions (ULTRA+)
- `client.kol.firstTouchSubscriptions.create(params)` — POST /rhc/kol/first-touches/subscriptions — push on a token's FIRST tracked-KOL buy. Filters are strict (unknown key = 400) and there is NO min_scout_tier/min_n_touches — min_kol_winrate is the quality gate (ULTRA+)
- `client.kol.firstTouchSubscriptions.get(id)` / `.update(id, params)` / `.delete(id)` — GET/PATCH/DELETE /rhc/kol/first-touches/subscriptions/{id} — UUID id; `filters` is a whole-object REPLACE, not a merge (ULTRA+)

### Streaming (client.stream) — PRO+
- `client.stream.getToken()` — POST /stream/token — 24h WS token
- `client.stream.connect()` — managed WebSocket. Channels: rhc:kol_trades (PRO+, event rhc:kol_trade), rhc:dex_trades (ULTRA+, event rhc:dex_trade; rhc:trades is a deprecated alias), rhc:copytrade:signals (PRO+, user-scoped, event rhc:copytrade:signal), rhc:price_alert:events (PRO+, user-scoped, ~15s polled, events rhc:price_alert:dip / rhc:price_alert:recovery), rhc:kol:coordination (PRO+, user-scoped, event rhc:kol:coordination), rhc:kol:first_touches (PRO+ broadcast, event rhc:kol:first_touch). Rejected channels (typo/tier gate) emit a "warning" lifecycle event ({ code: "channels_rejected", rejected, valid_channels }) instead of being silently dropped

## Error handling

All methods throw `RobinhoodError` with `.message`, `.status`, `.body`, and `.requestId` (`_rid`). 429 and 5xx responses are retried automatically with backoff.
